PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin lenses? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin lenses.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin lenses.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Thin lenses.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Dynamics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Circular motion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Floating and Sinking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Quantity of Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
